title: poly_rust: a domain-specific language for polytopal methods with a Rust interpreter
summary: Background: Over the last two decades, considerable effort in the applied mathematics community has been devoted to the development of polytopal methods, i.e., numerical methods for partial differential equations that support meshes more general than those used by traditional finite element methods. Despite their flexibility and attractive mathematical properties, polytopal methods have a steep implementation curve and, to date, no easily accessible open-source software framework has been available for their systematic implementation.
